name: SF YouthWorks
description: Paid internships at San Francisco City departments for high school juniors and seniors
fullDescription: SF YouthWorks, run by JCYC Workhub, gives San Francisco high school juniors and seniors paid internships at City departments, plus job readiness training and mentorship.
whatTheyOffer:
- Paid hourly internships at SF City departments (such as SFO, the Public Library, and the Public Utilities Commission)
- Paid job readiness workshops and training
- Mentorship from a City department employee
- Field trips, college campus tours, and career exploration
- Youth Leadership Team opportunities for returning interns
- Support planning for life after high school
howToGetIt:
1. Must be in 11th or 12th grade
2. Must live or attend school in San Francisco
3. Must be able to get a work permit (the program can help)
4. Apply online through JCYC Workhub
5. Questions: email jcycworkforce@jcyc.org
keywords: YouthWorks, San Francisco, youth employment, summer jobs, internship, high school, teen jobs, work experience, JCYC, city departments, public service
